title: SpeechDock · Choose the layout
question: All three use your Lucent / Rosé Pine design. Choose what should lead when you open the app.

options.label: Workspace
options.thesis: Recent jobs lead, with a ready-to-use upload panel beside them.
options.viewport: Activity in the centre, a compact transcription composer on the right, and clear navigation to models and settings.
options.risk: Less room for inspecting a long transcript until you open its detail.

options.label: Activity ledger
options.thesis: A wide activity list for monitoring Bazarr, with details beside the selected job.
options.viewport: Top navigation, job filters, a broad activity table and a selected-result pane. New uploads begin from the toolbar.
options.risk: More efficient for monitoring, but less welcoming for occasional manual uploads.

options.label: Transcription studio
options.thesis: Upload and subtitle preview take centre stage; background activity stays one tab away.
options.viewport: A large file-and-settings composer beside a readable result preview, with recent work below.
options.risk: Best for manual transcription; unattended Bazarr activity is less immediate.
